question: To whom is this Kaula teaching to be given, and to whom is it not?
premises: This Kaula is to be given to the worthy.
It is not to be given to just anyone.
inference: This Kaula teaching is to be given to the worthy, but not to whomever it may be.
plain_english: This Kaula is to be given to the worthy; it is not to be given to just anyone.
